Red Line Impact Model (RLIM)

Warehouse & Econometric Docs v0.4.0

Transit Capitalization, Market Liquidity, and Displacement Risk across Mecklenburg County Rail Corridors. Evaluating the entire 25-mile CATS Red Line alignment (Uptown Charlotte to Mooresville) using a quasi-experimental LYNX Blue Line Extension benchmark.

Mecklenburg County Cadastral & Deed Pipeline
DuckDB Analytical Engine
Architecture Overview

The pipeline operates on an idempotent DuckDB warehouse structured into raw ingestion (Bronze), standardized spatial features and deflated sales (Silver), and causal/econometric modeling views (Gold).

bronze.parcels — Mecklenburg County Tax Parcels (Bronze)
7 Columns

Raw cadastral parcel boundaries ingested from gis.charlottenc.gov CountyData MapServer.

Column Name Type Description & Econometric Specification Values / Range
parcel_id string Mecklenburg County Parcel Identification Number (PID). ['00101101', '00123456']
nc_pin string North Carolina permanent parcel identification number. ['00101101', '00123457']
raw_zoning string Municipal zoning classification code from county cadastral records. ['TOD-CC', 'R-3', 'UR-2', 'B-1']
shape_area_sqft number Official cadastral surface area in square feet calculated by county GIS engine. [19594.48, 34699.51]
calc_acreage number Calculated parcel land area in acres (shape_area_sqft / 43,560). [0.4498, 0.7966]
geom string Raw boundary geometry represented as WKT or internal spatial geometry (OGC:CRS84 / EPSG:4326). ['POLYGON ((-80.8431 35.4993, ...))']
ingest_timestamp datetime Timestamp when record entered the warehouse. ['2024-01-01T00:00:00Z', '2027-12-31T23:59:59Z']

10 Columns

Balanced stratum-year panel tracking annual transaction volume against total parcel inventory to evaluate market liquidity, turnover surges, and land banking assembly behavior.

Column Name Type Description & Econometric Specification Values / Range

turnover_rate_pct number Annual turnover percentage per 100 parcels ((tx_count / total_parcels) * 100). —
median_real_ppsf number Median real PPSF of transactions in cell (NULL for zero-transaction years). —
mean_real_ppsf number Mean real PPSF of transactions in cell (NULL for zero-transaction years). —
policy_era string Categorical transit lifecycle era: Pre-Grant Baseline, Anticipation / Construction, or Revenue Service. —

Methodological Transparency Statement
1. Land Footprint vs. Structural Capital:

Normalizing deed price by parcel footprint (ppsf_real_2026) isolates raw site assembly and redevelopment option value. For owner-occupied single-family residential properties, physical building characteristics (living area, structural condition) significantly influence transaction price. The model absorbs baseline structural scale through categorical zoning fixed effects (C(zoning_category)) and cross-corridor differencing.

2. Assessed Value Allocation Limits:

Municipal tax assessor splits frequently apply statutory allocation ratios (e.g., standardizing land to fixed percentages) that do not reflect rapid localized redevelopment pressure in urban transit walksheds. To avoid administrative appraisal measurement error, the dependent variable relies on verified arms-length market transactions.

3. Spatial Heterogeneity Across Corridor Typologies:

Evaluating the 25-mile corridor captures two distinct urban environments: high-density urban core infill and adaptive reuse (Center City to North Charlotte) versus suburban town centers (Huntersville, Cornelius, Davidson). Station-clustered standard errors and distance-to-CBD controls isolate localized platform accessibility from the regional monocentric wage gradient.

2. Real Land Value Distributions by Regional Corridor
3. Semi-Log Distance Gradient: Pre-Opening vs. Operational

Market Liquidity & Commercial Churn Divergence
GLM Poisson Panel
Land Assembly & Planned Residential Development

Developers of planned residential subdivisions acquire land parcels primarily for aggregate development footprint rather than existing structural utility. Model L2 isolates this mechanism by testing triple-difference turnover divergence across commercial/TOD parcels and consumer housing stock.

Theoretical Takeaway: Commercial and retail parcels in the treated Blue Line walkshed exhibited accelerated turnover. Institutional land assembly concentrates along commercial corridors ahead of revenue service, indicating that market liquidity adjusts before price levels reach equilibrium.
